title: Tiffany — USB camera / CPU-only live classification demo
status: Functional demo; hybrid integration and stage timing measurements pending
description: Arducam-1080P-HDR connected to DE1-SoC Linux, with TinyViT inference on the ARM Cortex-A9 HPS and live camera/prediction display on Windows. This earlier recording uses Windows preprocessing and is not evidence of an entirely HPS-local pipeline. Added November 17, 2026; exact capture date and source commit were not recorded. No FPGA offload or measured end-to-end speedup is claimed by this video.
